name: aws_scheduler_get_schedule
title: Get schedule details
description: Returns the schedule expression (ScheduleExpression), timezone, target, and state of one schedule

group_name.description: Schedule group name. If omitted, the default group is used

profile.description: AWS profile name. If omitted, the awscli default resolution applies

region.description: AWS region (e.g. ap-northeast-1). If omitted, the awscli default resolution applies

ActionAfterCompletion.description: Action after the schedule completes (NONE or DELETE) (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

EndDate.description: Time before which the schedule can invoke its target (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

GroupName.description: Schedule group name (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

KmsKeyArn.description: Customer managed KMS key ARN (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

LastModificationDate.description: Last modification time (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

ScheduleExpression.description: Schedule expression (at, rate, or cron) (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

ScheduleExpressionTimezone.description: Timezone of the schedule expression (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

StartDate.description: Time after which the schedule can invoke its target (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

State.description: ENABLED or DISABLED (EventBridge Scheduler GetSchedule response)

lines.description: Output split into lines (success only). Returned when the output is not a JSON object: commands without JSON output, empty output, or warnings only

output.description: Beginning of the redacted output when it exceeds the limit (success only, together with truncated)

truncated.description: true when the output exceeded the limit and output holds only its beginning (success only)

kind.description: Failure kind (failure only): not-allowed / invalid-input = rejected before running, timeout, awscli-missing, and the awscli failure kinds

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Redacted awscli output, only the beginning when it exceeds the limit (failure only)

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run, such as top-level keys of the awscli JSON output that the tool does not declare and dropped (omitted when there are none)
